+++ b/src/click/cleanup_documentation_context.py
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from .core import Context
+from .core import Group
+
+
+class CleanupDocumentationContext(Group):
+    """A group that cleans up subcommand contexts during documentation traversal."""
+
+    def to_info_dict(self, ctx: Context) -> dict[str, t.Any]:
+        info_dict = super(Group, self).to_info_dict(ctx)
+        commands = {}
+
+        for name in self.list_commands(ctx):
+            command = self.get_command(ctx, name)
+
+            if command is None:
+                continue
+
+            sub_ctx = ctx._make_sub_context(command)
+
+            with sub_ctx.scope(cleanup=True):
+                commands[name] = command.to_info_dict(sub_ctx)
+
+        info_dict.update(commands=commands, chain=self.chain)
+        return info_dict
notes:
The new subclass mirrors Group.to_info_dict and enables cleanup when each subcommand scope exits. It preserves the original method resolution after Group and leaves existing modules unchanged.
